name: Leucippus & Democritus: Atoms
blurb: Greek philosophers declare the world is composed of atoms. ~450 BCE.

name: Hero of Alexandria Invents the Aeolipile
blurb: Hero of Alexandria invents the aeoliphile; a steam powered pinwheel. ~150 CE.

name: Alchemists Seek to Transmute Base Metals
blurb: Artists of Alchemy attempts to transmute base metals in to gold.

name: Newton's 'New Theory of Light and Colors'
blurb: Isaac Newton's New Theory of Light and Colors appears in the Philosophical Transactions. 1671.

name: John Dalton Presents Atomic Theory
blurb: John Dalton presents his atomic theory suggesting that each element is composed of identical atoms whose properties determine the chemical reactivity of that element.

name: Carnot: 'Reflections on the Motive Power of Fire'
blurb: Nicolas Leonard Sadi Carnot published first theoretical understanding of steam power in Reflections on the Motive Power of Fire.

name: Happy Birthday, Nikola Tesla!
blurb: Happy Birthday Nikola Tesla!

name: Einstein: Inertia, Energy & Mass-Energy Equivalence
blurb: Annalen der Physik receives Does the Inertia of a Body Depend Upon Its Energy Content? By Albert Einstein showing equivalency of mass and energy by E=MC2.

name: Paneth & Peters Report Possible Nuclear Fusion
blurb: Fritz Paneth and Kurt Peters report possible nuclear fusion causing anomalous heat from palladium hydrides in Berlin Germany.

name: Paneth & Peters Report Hydrogen-to-Helium Transmutation
blurb: Fritz Paneth and Kurt Peters report in Nature experiments possibly transmuting hydrogen into helium.

name: Happy Birthday, Martin Fleischmann!
blurb: Happy Birthday Martin Fleischmann!

name: Hans Bethe: Energy Production in Stars
blurb: Hans Bethe submits paper Energy Production in Stars to Physical Review on fusion reactions in the Sun.

name: First Nuclear Chain Reaction at Chicago
blurb: Enrico Fermi initiates first chain reaction at University of Chicago.

name: Happy Birthday, Stanley Pons!
blurb: Happy Birthday Stanley Pons!

name: Hubbert: Nuclear Energy and Fossil Fuels
blurb: M. King Hubbert presents Nuclear Energy and Fossil Fuels to the American Petroleum Institute predicting a peak in global oil production and the use of nuclear power to replace it.

name: Rafelski & Jones: Cold Nuclear Fusion in Sci. American
blurb: J. Rafelski and Steve Jones publish Cold Nuclear Fusion in Scientific American.

name: Fleischmann & Pons Visit Steve Jones at BYU
blurb: Martin Fleischmann and Stanley Pons visit Steve Jones at Brigham Young University (BYU) and learn of imminent publishing of similar anomalous heat results.

name: Hugo Rossi Coins 'F-Day' Term
blurb: May 8 would be “f-day” chemists' revenge on physicists.

name: Fleischmann & Pons Submit Research to JEC
blurb: Martin Fleischmann and Stanley Pons submit their research for publication.

name: Fleischmann & Pons / U of Utah
blurb: Martin Fleischmann and Stanley Pons file U.S. patent application that becomes US 4,943,355 “Method for Producing Power and Treating Materials,” assigned to the University of Utah Research Foundation; granted July 24, 1990. https://patents.google.com/patent/US4943355A/en

name: Fleischmann & Pons Announce Cold Fusion at Utah
blurb: Martin Fleischmann and Stanley Pons of University of Utah Salt Lake City announce their discovery of nuclear-sized excess heat in a test-tube.

name: SRI International Begins Cold Fusion Experiments
blurb: SRI International of Menlo Park, California begins experiments.

name: Utah Governor Convenes Funding Session
blurb: Utah Governor Norm Bangerter convenes state legislature to consider funding for cold fusion.

name: Navy China Lake Cold Fusion Program Begins
blurb: Navy's China Lake cold fusion program begins.

name: Steve Jones Announces BYU Cold Fusion Work
blurb: Steve Jones of BYU announces previous work that demonstrates fusion can occur at room-temperature.

name: Rubbia Hosts Fleischmann at CERN
blurb: Nobel Laureate Carlo Rubbia warmly hosts Martin Fleischmann at European Center for Nuclear Research (CERN)

name: Hungary Reports Neutron Detection
blurb: Gyula Csikai and Tibor Szaricskai at Lajos Kossuth University in Hungary report duplication of Fleischmann-Pons Effect (FPE)

name: BARC India Begins Cold Fusion Experiments
blurb: Bhabha Atomic Research Center (BARC) begins cold fusion experiments under direction of P.K. Iyengar.

name: Oyama Reports Excess Heat at Tokyo University
blurb: Noboru Oyama at Tokyo University observe large amounts of heat from cold fusion cell.

name: Bockris Finds Tritium in Electrolytic Cells
blurb: John Bockris and N.J.C. Packham find tritium in electrolytic cells.

name: Frascati: Scaramuzzi Detects Neutrons
blurb: Francesco Scaramuzzi of Italian Agency for Nuclear and Alternative Energy (ENEA) measures neutron burst 600 times in excess of normal background from gas-loaded palladium.

name: Utah Cold Fusion Research Legislation
blurb: State of Utah passes cold fusion research legislation.

name: Utah Approves $5M for Cold Fusion Research
blurb: State of Utah approves $5 million for cold fusion research if Fleischmann and Pons' results are confirmed.

name: Fleischmann, Pons & Hawkins Publish in JEC
blurb: Fleischmann, Pons, and Hawkins Electrochemically Induced Nuclear Fusion of Deuterium published in Journal of Electroanalytical Chemistry.

name: Texas A&M Reports 60-80% Excess Heat
blurb: Texas A&M reports 60-80% excess heat, remain cautious about nuclear origin.

name: Pons at ACS President's Event
blurb: “Fusion in the rod produced 4 watts energy for every watt used to run the cell.” Stanley Pons from F. David Peat.

name: Tass: Moscow University Detects Neutrons
blurb: Tass reports Runar Kuzmin of Moscow University detects neutrons “confirming room-temperature fusion”

name: Mathews et al
blurb: Dr. Mathews et al. at Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research in India replicates FPE.

name: Seaborg Tells Bush Utah Claims 'Not Right'
blurb: Glenn Seaborg tells President Bush that University of Utah claims are “not fusion”, but should be investigated anyway.

name: Fusion Information Center Founded
blurb: Fusion Information Center incorporates in Utah.

name: Pons Announces 800-Hour Sustained Reaction
blurb: Stanley Pons announces a reaction has been sustained for 800 hours in one of his cells, producing 80 times energy return.

name: Scaramuzzi & ENEA Announce Neutron Detection
blurb: Francesco Scaramuzzi and Italian Atomic Energy Authority announce detection of neutrons from gas-loaded Titanium-Deuterium cell.

name: Stanford Reports Excess Heat
blurb: Robert Huggins et al. At Stanford University announces confirmation of Fleischmann-Pons Effect (FPE)

name: Huggins (Stanford) Replicates FPE
blurb: Successful replication of FPE is reported by Robert Huggins at Stanford University, and by physicists in Czechoslovakia and India.

name: BARC India: Anomalous Neutron Bursts
blurb: P.K. Iyengarand Mahadeva Srinivasan et al. Measureanomalousneutronburstsmeasuredfromelectrolytic cells cold fusion cells at BARC in Mumbai, India. (See also CFN Podcast #7: https://www.lackluster.org/cf/#2018-3-23)

name: Watkins Establishes DoE Cold Fusion Review Panel
blurb: One month after the announcement U.S. Energy Secretary James Watkins establishes review panel to evaluate cold fusion claims.

name: Tata Institute Reports Excess Heat from Titanium
blurb: Tata Institute in Bombay, India reports excess heat using titanium.

name: Pons Briefs U.S. Congress on Cold Fusion
blurb: Stanley Pons briefs the U.S. House Science, Space and Technology committee on cold fusion.

name: Steve Jones Publishes Observation of Cold Nuclear Fusion
blurb: “Observation of Cold Nuclear Fusion in Condensed Matter” by Steve Jones et al. From BYU published in Nature. 1989. PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/JonesSEobservatio.pdf

name: Japan's MITI Begins Cold Fusion Studies
blurb: Japanese Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) begins major research initiative.

name: Case Western Reports Excess Heat & Tritium
blurb: Team at Case Western University reports excess heat and tritium from electrolytic.

name: Chubb Organizes First Cold Fusion APS Session
blurb: Scott Chubb organizes first session on cold fusion at an American Physical Society meeting.

name: APS Meeting Denounces Cold Fusion
blurb: Physicists at American Physical Society (APS) meeting hotly denounce the work of Martin Fleischmann and Stanley Pons.

name: Bockris Confirms at Texas A&M
blurb: Third team at Texas A&M headed by John Bockris confirms Fleischmann-Pons Effect (FPE)

name: India: Ten Teams Replicate Fleischmann-Pons
blurb: Mumbai's The Indian Post reports ten teams in India replicate the Fleischmann-Pons Effect (FPE)

name: F-Day at Electrochemical Society Meeting
blurb: F-day at Electrochemical Society Meeting.

name: Fleischmann & Pons at Electrochemical Society LA
blurb: Martin Fleischmann and Stanley Pons provide additional data at a meeting of the Electrochemical Society in Los Angeles, California.

name: Fleischmann, Pons & Hawkins Publish JEC Errata
blurb: Fleischmann, Pons, and Hawkins publish errata in Journal of Electroanalytical Chemistry.

name: Ten Teams Report FPE Replication
blurb: Ten teams report success replicating the FPE at cold fusion meeting at Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) near Mumbai, India.

name: Multi-Lab Confirmations of Fleischmann-Pons Effect
blurb: Case-Western Reserve, Texas A&M, U. of Florida, U. of Washington and the National Institute of Nuclear Physics at Frascati, Italy have all confirmed parts of the Fleischmann-Pons Effect.

name: First LANL Workshop on Cold Fusion
blurb: The Workshop on Cold Fusion Phenomenon held at Los Alamos National Lab in New Mexico is the first cold fusion conference ever held.

name: Mexican Scientists Confirm Solid-State Fusion
blurb: A team of Mexican scientists report confirmation of solid-state fusion.

name: First Issue of Fusion Facts Published
blurb: First issue of Fusion Facts is published by Hal Fox announcing cold fusion is real and has commercial possibilities.

name: BARC: Tritium Increase from Cold Fusion Cells
blurb: P.K. Iyengar and Mahadeva Srinivasan et al. measure four-fold increase of tritium from cold fusion cell. (See also CFN Podcast #7: https://www.lackluster.org/cf/#2018-3-23)

name: MIT 'Wake for Cold Fusion' Party
blurb: MIT Plasma Fusion Center holds Wake for Cold Fusion Party at 4PM claiming cold fusion is dead.

name: Storms & Talcott Detect Tritium at LANL
blurb: Edmund Storms and Carol Talcott from LANL detect tritium “in significant amounts” from Pd-D electrolytic cells. (See also CFN podcast #19: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

name: Cold Nuclear Fusion Paper by S.E. Jones et al
blurb: Cold Nuclear Fusion by S.E. Jones and J. Rafelski published in Scientific American.

name: Hal Fox Founds Fusion Information Center
blurb: Fusion Information Center founded by Hal Fox publishes first issue of Fusion Facts.

name: Ten Teams Report Cold Fusion Success in Japan
blurb: Ten teams report successful experiments at cold fusion conference held in Japan.

name: U of Utah Approves National Cold Fusion Institute
blurb: University of Utah Regents approve National Cold Fusion Institute.

name: U.S. National Cold Fusion Institute Formed
blurb: The U.S. National Cold Fusion Institute in Salt Lake City, Utah is formed.

name: Piantelli Discovers Excess Heat in Ni-H System
blurb: Francesco Piantelli discovers extreme excess heat in a gas-loaded nickel-hydrogen system.

name: Japan Forms National Cold Fusion Working Group
blurb: Japan organizes a working group on cold fusion in the National Institute for Fusion Science.

name: Fusion Technology Special Section on Cold Fusion
blurb: George Miley editor of Fusion Technology announces special section in the Journal of the American Nuclear Society. 1989. Bibliography: https://lenr-canr.org/

name: Electrochemical Society Hollywood Meeting
blurb: Four-day meeting of Electrochemical Society begins in Hollywood, Florida with 20 mostly positive cold fusion papers presented.

name: NSF & EPRI Confirm New Phenomenon
blurb: National Science Foundation (NSF) and Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) hold meeting in Washington, D.C.

name: Texas A&M: 'Something Nuclear Taking Place'
blurb: Paul Chu and A. John Appleby of Texas A&M states “We are now very comfortable that what we are seeing here is something that is not chemical; it is something nuclear taking place.”

name: DoE ERAB Approves Final Report Dismissing Cold Fusion
blurb: The DoE Energy Research Advisory Board (ERAB) approves final report dismissing cold fusion evidence.

name: DoE ERAB: Cold Fusion Evidence 'Not Persuasive'
blurb: U.S. Department of Energy ERAB report concludes evidence for cold fusion is “not persuasive” despite numerous successful replications.

name: F. David Peat: The Making of a Scientific Controversy
blurb: Cold Fusion: The Making of a Scientific Controversy by F. David Peat is the first book on cold fusion. https://archive.org/details/coldfusionmakingo0000peat

name: Fusion Facts: Fleischmann & Pons Scientists of the Year
blurb: Fusion Facts names Martin Fleischmann and Stanley Pons as Fusion Scientists of the Year.

name: DoE Gajewsky Tracks Cold Fusion Funding
blurb: Division of Advanced Energy Projects Director at U.S. Department of Energy Ryszard Gajewski announces funding for cold fusion, his budget is later slashed and he is replaced.

name: Fritz Will Heads National Cold Fusion Institute
blurb: Fritz Will begins as head of National Cold Fusion Institute at University of Utah.

name: Matsumoto Reports Hokkaido Cold Fusion Results
blurb: Takaaki Matsumoto of Hokkaido University Sapporo Japan reports cold fusion from ordinary water.

name: ICCF-1: First Cold Fusion Conference
blurb: ICCF-1 — International Conference on Cold Fusion held in Salt Lake City, Utah, USA. Proceedings / info: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/EPRIproceeding.pdf

name: Belton / BHP
blurb: Geoffrey R. Belton (Broken Hill Proprietary Co., Australia) files WO 1990/013124 A1 “Cold Nuclear Fusion Method and Apparatus” — gas-phase deuterium loading via RF/microwave glow discharge into Pd tube. https://patents.google.com/patent/WO1990013124A1/en

name: Russian Glow-Discharge Cold Fusion Observation
blurb: A.B. Karabut, Ya.R. Kucherov, and I.V. Savvatimova present Cold Fusion Observation at Gas-Discharge Device Cathode.

name: Storms
blurb: Edmund Storms of Los Alamos National Lab (LANL) compiles survey of 16 successes in tritium detection, 15 in neutron detection, and 19 successes replicating the FPE. (See also CFN podcast #19: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

name: Liebert & Liaw at U Hawaii: 500% Excess Power
blurb: Bruce Liebert, Bor Yann Kiaw et al. at University of Hawaii report multi-watt excess power output of 500%.

name: Fleischmann & Pons: Pd-D2O Calorimetry
blurb: Key Experiment: Calorimetry of the palladium-deuterium-heavy water system by M. Fleischmann and S. Pons. 1990 PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/Fleischmancalorimetr.pdf

name: Oriani: Calorimetric Excess Power Measurement
blurb: Key Experiment: Calorimetric Measurement of Excess Power Output During the Cathodic Charging of Deuterium into palladium by R. Oriani. 1990. PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/OrianiRAcalorimetr.pdf

name: Storms & Talcott: Electrolytic Tritium Production
blurb: Key Experiment: A Study of Electrolytic Tritium Production by Edmund Storms and Carol Talcott. 1990 PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/StormsEastudyofel.pdf (See also CFN podcast #19: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

name: Cornell Assembles Cold Fusion Archives
blurb: Cornell University announces assembly of cold fusion archives.

name: Fusion Facts: 112 Confirming Papers from 16 Countries
blurb: Fusion Facts reports on 112 papers confirming excess heat and nuclear activity from 16 countries.

name: BYU Cold Fusion Conference: Proof Below Critical Mass
blurb: conference on held at BYU Provo, Utah produces proof cold fusion can occur in deuterated systems without being catalyzed by muons.

name: BYU: Helium-4 Detection in Pd Electrodes
blurb: Helium-4 is detected in Pd electrode and Czechoslovakia reports low-level neutrons.

name: National Cold Fusion Institute Hosts Scientific Review
blurb: National Cold Fusion Institute hosts scientific review of cold fusion work.

name: Fleischmann & Pons Leave Utah for Nice, France
blurb: Martin Fleischmann and Stanley Pons leave Utah to work in Nice, France.

name: Takahashi Detects Lower-Energy Neutrons at Osaka
blurb: Akito Takahashi of Osaka University detects neutrons with lower energy than expected.

name: Miles & Bush: Helium-4 as Cold Fusion By-Product
blurb: Naval Researcher Melvin Miles and Benjamin Bush of University of Texas Austin report Helium-4 as a nuclear by-product of cold fusion. (See also CFN podcast #12: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

name: Mizuno Witnesses 'Heat After Death'
blurb: Tadahiko Mizuno witnesses astonishing “heat after death” event.

name: Randall Mills: Excess Heat from Ni & Light Water
blurb: Randall Mills announces generation of significant excess heat from nickel and light-water cells.

name: Three Lab Explosions in China
blurb: Zhang Xinwie et al. experience three explosions in their lab.

name: Stan Szpak: Pd-D Co-deposition Method
blurb: Navy researcher Stan Szpak et al publish on a new method of initiating the reaction that he developed using electro-deposited palladium-deuteride. 1991 ..... in Journal Electroanalytical Chemistry.

name: Mallove Publishes 'Fire from Ice'
blurb: Fire from Ice: Searching for the Truth Behind the Cold Fusion Furor by Eugene Mallove is published. https://archive.org/details/firefromicesearc0000mall

name: Gluck & Palibroda: Pd Thin-Foil Cold Fusion
blurb: Cold Nuclear Fusion in Thin Foils of Palladium by Peter Gluck and Evelina Palibroda reports finding neutrons.

name: Mallove Resigns from MIT News Office
blurb: Eugene Mallove formally resigns as MIT News Office Chief Science Writer.

name: Fusion Facts: 242 Positive Papers from 23 Countries
blurb: Fusion Facts publishes a review of 242 positive papers from 23 countries.

name: Bush & Eagleton Report Record Excess Heat
blurb: Robert Bush and Robert Eagleton report record amount of excess heat at ICCF-2.

name: ICCF-2: 2nd International Cold Fusion Conference
blurb: ICCF-2 — International Conference on Cold Fusion held in Como, Italy. Proceedings / info: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/BressaniTtheicc.pdf

name: National Cold Fusion Institute Closes
blurb: U.S. National Cold Fusion Institute in Salt Lake City, Utah closes.

name: Miles & Bush Present Heat-Helium at ICCF-2
blurb: Melvin Miles, Benjamin Bush et al. present Heat and Helium Production in Cold Fusion Experiments at ICCF-2. (See also CFN podcast #12: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

name: Mills: K2CO3 Aqueous Excess Heat Experiment
blurb: Key Experiment: Excess Heat Production by the Electrolysis of an Aqueous Potassium Carbonate Electrolyte and the Implications for Cold Fusion by Randall Mills and Steven O. Kneizys. *1991. PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/MillsRLexcessheat.pdf

name: Ikegami/Technova Files EP 0477018 A1
blurb: Hideo Ikegami (Technova Inc., Tokyo) files EP 0477018 A1 “Apparatus and method for utilizing heat generated owing to Fleischmann-Pons effect” — heat-pipe / thermoelectric / Stirling extractor with CPU-controlled feedback. https://patents.google.com/patent/EP0477018A1/en

name: Naval Research Lab Detects Neutrons
blurb: Dr. Chambers, G. Hubler, and K. Grabowski of Naval Research Lab find neutrons.

name: Matsumoto et al. Report Heavy Element Transmutation
blurb: Takaaki Matsumoto et al. at Hokkaido University report heavy elements produced during cold fusion.

name: Schwinger: Pathological Skepticism Talk at MIT
blurb: Nobel Laureate Julian Schwinger talks at MIT saying “The circumstances of cold fusion are not those of hot fusion.”

name: Yun et al. Report Heat Bursts in Seoul
blurb: Kyun Suk Yun et al. From the Institute of Science and Technology in Seoul, South Korea report heat bursts in Pd-D electrolytic cells.

name: Denmark: Anomalous Ni-H Behavior
blurb: Dr. Nielsen et al. of Denmark prove unusual behavior of Nickel-Hydrogen chains.

name: Piantelli: Excess Heat from Ni-H Cell
blurb: Francesco Piantelli observes excess heat from nickel-hydrogen cell.

name: Massive Excess Heat at Osaka
blurb: Akito Takahashi of Osaka University reports massive excess heat and low-level neutron emission from cell operating over a month.

name: Mallove & Swartz Meet DoE Secretary Watkins
blurb: Eugene Mallove and Mitchell Swartz meet with DoE Secretary James Watkins.

name: Noninski et al. Report Ni-H Excess Heat
blurb: Vesco Noninski et al. Of LEPGER in Sofia, Bulgaria report excess heat using nickel-hydrogen and potassium-carbonate system.

name: Japan's MITI Funds 4-Year Cold Fusion Program
blurb: Japan's MITI funds four-year cold fusion program with Hitachi, Toshiba, Toyota, Tokyo Electric Power, and others.

name: Storms Replicates Takahashi Excess Heat
blurb: Edmund Storms announces replication of Akito Takahashi excess heat. (See also CFN podcast #19: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

name: Re-Analysis of MIT 1989 Cold Fusion Data
blurb: Mitchell Swartz publishes re-analysis of MIT's 1989 cold fusion experiments showing apparent excess heat in the original data. https://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/SwartzMreexamining.pdf

name: Arata & Zhang: Reproducible Cold Fusion Reaction
blurb: Yoshiaki Arata and Yue-Chang Zhang publish Reproducible Cold Fusion Reaction Using a Complex Cathode.

name: Robert Bush: Light-Water Excess Heat (Alkali-H Fusion)
blurb: Robert Bush of California State Polytechnic University publishes A Light Water Excess Heat Reaction Suggests Cold Fusion is Alkali-Hydrogen Fusion in Fusion Technology V.22.

name: MITI Announces New Hydrogen Energy Program
blurb: The Japanese Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) announced New Hydrogen Energy, a four-year program to develop cold fusion into a practical energy source.

name: McKubre Presents SRI Cold Fusion Summary at MIT
blurb: Michael McKubre of SRI International presents a summary of their work to a group at MIT. (See also CFN podcast #2, #13: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

name: Glow Discharge Nuclear Product Ratio (Russia)
blurb: Key Experiment: Nuclear Product Ratio for Glow Discharge in Deuterium.

name: Notoya: Large Excess Heat at Hokkaido
blurb: Professor Notoya of Hokkaido University Japan reports a large amount of excess heat form light-water systems.

name: ICCF-3: 3rd International Cold Fusion Conference
blurb: ICCF-3 — International Conference on Cold Fusion held in Nagoya, Japan. Proceedings / info: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/IkegamiHthirdintera.pdf

name: Arthur C. Clarke: Coming Age of Hydrogen Power
blurb: Arthur C. Clarke gives cold fusion speech “2001: The Coming Age of Hydrogen Power”

name: Storms Testifies Before U.S. Congress
blurb: Edmund Storms testifies before the U.S. House Subcommittee on Science, Space, and Technology. (See also CFN podcast #19: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

name: Reproducible Tritium in Pd Cathodes (NCFI)
blurb: Key Experiment: Reproducible Tritium Generation in Electrochemical Cells.

name: ICCF-4: 4th International Cold Fusion Conference
blurb: ICCF-4 — International Conference on Cold Fusion held in Lahaina, Maui, Hawaii, USA. Proceedings / info: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/PassellTOfourthinter.pdf

name: Cold Fusion Magazine Launches with Mallove as Editor
blurb: Cold Fusion magazine launches by Wayne Green and colleagues with Eugene Mallove as Editor. Archived at: https://infinite-energy.com/coldfusionmagazine/

name: Focardi, Habel & Piantelli: High-Temperature Anomalous Heat
blurb: Sergio Focardi, Roberto Habel and Francesco Piantelli announce high-temperature anomalous excess heat.

name: Documentary: Too Close to the Sun
blurb: Landmark documentary Too Close to the Sun on the early history of the cold fusion underground airs. Watch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CZKRXabsa4I IMDb: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt2331825/

name: Patent: US 5,318,675 — Patterson / CETI Electrolysis
blurb: James Patterson / Clean Energy Technologies Inc. (CETI) granted US 5,318,675 — System for the electrolysis of water using a porous matrix of micron-sized beads. https://patents.google.com/patent/US5318675A/en

name: McKubre & Tanzella: Isothermal Flow Calorimetry
blurb: Key Experiment: Isothermal Flow Calorimetric Investigations by M. McKubre. 1994. PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/McKubreMCHisothermala.pdf (See also CFN podcast #2, #13, #17: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

name: Piantelli/Focardi/Habel: 900 MJ from Ni-H
blurb: Francesco Piantelli, Sergio Focardi, V.Gabbani, V. Montalbano, and S. Veronisi create excess energy of over 900 MegaJoules using nickel and light-hydrogen.

name: Reifenschweiler: Reduced Radioactivity of Tritium
blurb: Key Experiment: Reduced Radioactivity of Tritium by Otto Reifenschweiler. 1994. PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/Reifenschwreducedrad.pdf

name: John Dash: Surface Morphology & Excess Heat
blurb: Key Experiment: Surface Morphology and … correlation with Excess Heat by John Dash, G. Noble and D. Diman at Portland State University Physics.

name: Patterson / CETI: Electrolysis Patent
blurb: James Patterson / CETI granted US 5,372,688 — System for electrolysis of water using a porous-matrix bead-pack cathode (Patterson Power Cell). https://patents.google.com/patent/US5372688A/en

name: Cold Fusion Day at MIT
blurb: Eugene Mallove conducts IAP short course at Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) calling it Cold Fusion Day.

name: Mizuno: Pd Analysis Shows Transmutations
blurb: Tadahiko Mizuno receives palladium analysis results showing existence of “new” elements, possibly transmutations.

name: Infinite Energy Magazine Launches
blurb: Eugene Mallove, Jed Rothwell and Chris Tinsley launch Infinite Energy magazine, still in publication. https://infinite-energy.com/

name: ICCF-5: 5th International Cold Fusion Conference
blurb: ICCF-5 — International Conference on Cold Fusion held in Monte Carlo, Monaco. Proceedings / info: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/PonsSproceeding.pdf

name: Biberian: Excess Heat in AlLaO3:D
blurb: Excess Heat Measurement in AlLaO3 Doped with Deuterium by Jean-Paul Biberian from Sciences de Luminy Physics in Monaco, France. PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/PonsSproceeding.pdf#page=65 (See also CFN Podcast #4: https://www.lackluster.org/cf/#2018-2-14)

name: First LENR/Transmutation Conference at Texas A&M
blurb: First Conference on Low Energy Nuclear Reactions (Transmutations) held at Texas A&M University.

name: CETI Demonstrates Patterson Power Cell
blurb: Clean Energy Technologies Inc. (CETI) demonstrates 1300 Watts Out in Anaheim.

name: NASA Lewis: Replication of Excess Heat Effect
blurb: NASA Lewis Research Center releases Replication of the Apparent Excess Heat Effect in a Light-Water-Potassium-Carbonate-Nickel Electrolytic Cell by Janis Niedra, Ira Meyers, Gustave Fralick, and Richard Baldwin.

name: Patterson / CETI: Electrolytic Cell Patent
blurb: James Patterson / CETI granted US 5,494,559 — System for electrolytic processing including a Patterson Power Cell. https://patents.google.com/patent/US5494559A/en

name: China Reviews Normal Temp. Nuclear Fusion
blurb: Normal Temperature Nuclear Fusion conference in China reviews progress of research groups, confirming the excess heat effect.

name: Oriani: Excess Heat Using Mizuno Method
blurb: Oriani at University of Minnesota obtains excess heat using Mizuno's proton conductors.

name: Miley & Patterson: Nuclear Transmutations
blurb: Key Experiment: Nuclear Transmutations by George Miley and James Patterson.

name: Navy: Anomalous Effects in Deuterated Systems
blurb: Key Experiment: Anomalous Effects in Deuterated Systems by Melvin Miles, Benjamin Bush, and Kendall Johnson at Naval Air Warfare Center. PDF: https://apps.dtic.mil/sti/tr/pdf/ADA315020.pdf (See also CFN podcast #12: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

name: Xing Zhong Li: Gas-Loaded D/Pd Excess Heat
blurb: Key Experiment: Excess Heat Measurement in Gas-loading D/Pd System by Xing Zhong Li. 1996. PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/LiXZexcessheat.pdf

name: ICCF-6: 6th International Cold Fusion Conference
blurb: ICCF-6 — International Conference on Cold Fusion held in Toya, Hokkaido, Japan. Proceedings / info: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/NEDOthesixthin.pdf

name: Miley & Patterson: Ni Thin-Film Transmutations
blurb: Key Experiment: Nuclear Transmutations in Thin-Film Nickel Coatings by George Miley. 1996. PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/MileyGHnucleartra.pdf

name: Srinivasan: Anomalous Pd Emissions
blurb: Key Experiment: Reproducible, Anomalous Emissions form Palladium Deuteride/Hydride by M. Srinivasan et al. at Bhabha Atomic Research Centre in India. *1996. PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/RoutRKreproducib.pdf (See also CFN Podcast #7: https://www.lackluster.org/cf/#2018-3-23)

name: Arata: Solid-State Plasma Fusion Paper
blurb: Key Experiment: Solid State Plasma Fusion by Yoshiaki Arata. 1997. PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/NEDOthesixthin.pdf#page=144

name: Movie: The Saint (Eugene Mallove as Technical Consultant)
